parsed.post: Increased DEPTH to 6 and ASPECT_RATIO to 64 resulted in val_bpb 0.919172, beating my previous best (0.922807). The capacity increase is consistent. Now I will test if reducing the learning rate helps stabilize this larger model and improve compression.
parsed.description: Testing lower learning rate (0.05) and a small amount of warmup (0.05) to stabilize the deeper, wider architecture.
